about: Slack's permission scopes, each with the description Slack's scopes reference gives it: what an admin sees for an app's scope (admin.apps.requests.list, admin.apps.approved.list, admin.apps.restricted.list).

scopes.admin.analytics:read: Access analytics data about the organization
scopes.admin.app_activities:read: View execution logs within an organization
scopes.admin.apps:read: View apps and app requests in a workspace
scopes.admin.barriers:read: Read information barriers in the organization
scopes.admin.barriers:write: Manage information barriers in the organization
scopes.admin.chat:write: Delete, restore, and update messages in conversations
scopes.admin.conversations:manage_objects: Manage channel details and create conversations related to external connections, objects, and records
scopes.admin.conversations:read: View the channel's member list, topic, purpose and channel name
scopes.admin.conversations:write: Start a new conversation, modify a conversation and modify channel details
scopes.admin.invites:read: View a workspace's invites and invite requests
scopes.admin.invites:write: Invite members to a workspace and approve or deny invitation requests
scopes.admin.roles:read: List role assignments for your workspace.
scopes.admin.roles:write: Add and remove role assignments for your workspace.
scopes.admin.workflows:read: View all workflows in a workspace
scopes.app_configurations:read: Read app configuration info via App Manifest APIs. When used by a manager app, access is restricted to apps created by that manager app.
scopes.app_configurations:write: Create apps and write app configuration info via App Manifest APIs. When used by a manager app, access is restricted to apps created by that manager app.
scopes.app_mentions:read: View messages that directly mention your Slack app in conversations that the app is in
scopes.apps.requests:write: Create or cancel an App Approval request on user's behalf
scopes.assistant:write: Allow your Slack app to act as an App Agent
scopes.auditlogs:read: View events from all workspaces, channels and users (Enterprise orgs only)
scopes.authorizations:read: Grants permission to list authorizations associated with the Events API
scopes.bot: Add the ability for people to direct message or mention @your_slack_app
scopes.calls:read: View information about ongoing and past calls
scopes.calls:write: Start and manage calls in a workspace
scopes.canvases:read: Access contents of canvases created inside Slack.
scopes.channels:history: View messages and other content in public channels that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.channels:join: Join public channels in a workspace
scopes.channels:manage: Manage public channels that your Slack app has been added to and create new ones
scopes.channels:read: View basic information about public channels in a workspace
scopes.channels:write: Manage a user's public channels and create new ones on a user's behalf
scopes.channels:write.topic: Set the description of public channels
scopes.chat:write: Send messages as your Slack app
scopes.chat:write.customize: Send messages as your Slack app with a customized username and avatar
scopes.chat:write.public: Send messages to channels your Slack app isn't a member of
scopes.client: Receive all events from a workspace in real time
scopes.commands: Add shortcuts and slash commands that people can use
scopes.connections:write: Grants permission to generate websocket URIs and connect to Socket Mode
scopes.conversations.connect:manage: Allows your Slack app to manage Slack Connect channels
scopes.conversations.connect:read: Receive Slack Connect invite events sent to the channels your Slack app is in
scopes.conversations.connect:write: Create Slack Connect invitations for channels that your Slack app has been added to, and accept invitations sent to your Slack app
scopes.datastore:read: View and see data from Slack App Datastore
scopes.datastore:write: Write data to Slack App Datastore
scopes.dnd:read: View Do Not Disturb settings for people in a workspace
scopes.dnd:write: Edit a user's Do Not Disturb settings
scopes.emoji:read: View custom emoji in a workspace
scopes.files:read: View files shared in channels and conversations that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.files:write: Upload, edit, and delete files as your Slack app
scopes.groups:history: View messages and other content in private channels that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.groups:read: View basic information about private channels that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.groups:write: Manage private channels that your Slack app has been added to and create new ones
scopes.groups:write.topic: Set the description of private channels
scopes.hosting:read: View and see information about Slack apps
scopes.identify: View information about a user's identity
scopes.im:history: View messages and other content in direct messages that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.im:read: View basic information about direct messages that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.im:write.topic: Set the description in direct messages
scopes.incoming-webhook: Post messages to specific channels in Slack
scopes.links:write: Show previews of URLs in messages
scopes.links.embed:write: Embed video player URLs in messages and app surfaces
scopes.lists:write: Create, edit, and delete Slack Lists
scopes.mcp:connect: Allows your Slack app to connect to Slack AI features through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
scopes.metadata.message:read: Allows your Slack app to read message metadata in channels that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.mpim:history: View messages and other content in group direct messages that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.mpim:read: View basic information about group direct messages that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.mpim:write: Start group direct messages with people
scopes.mpim:write.topic: Set the description in group direct messages
scopes.openid: View information about a user's identity
scopes.pins:read: View pinned content in channels and conversations that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.pins:write: Add and remove pinned messages and files
scopes.profile: View a user's Slack avatar and Slack workspace's basic information
scopes.reactions:read: View emoji reactions and their associated content in channels and conversations that your Slack app has been added to
scopes.reminders:read: View reminders created by your Slack app
scopes.reminders:write: Add, remove, or mark reminders as complete
scopes.remote_files:read: View remote files added by the app in a workspace
scopes.remote_files:share: Share remote files on a user's behalf
scopes.remote_files:write: Add, edit, and delete remote files on a user's behalf
scopes.search:read.files: Search a workspace's content in files
scopes.search:read.im: Search a workspace's content in direct messages
scopes.search:read.mpim: Search a workspace's content in group direct messages
scopes.search:read.private: Search a workspace's content in private channels
scopes.search:read.public: Search a workspace's content in public channels
scopes.stars:read: View a user's starred messages and files
scopes.stars:write: Add or remove stars for a user
scopes.team:read: View the name, email domain, and icon for workspaces your Slack app is connected to
scopes.team.billing:read: Allows your Slack app to read the billing plan for workspaces your Slack app has been installed to
scopes.team.preferences:read: Allows your Slack app to read the preferences for workspaces your Slack app has been installed to
scopes.tokens.basic: Execute methods without needing a scope
scopes.usergroups:read: View user groups in a workspace
scopes.users:read.email: View email addresses of people in a workspace
scopes.users:write: Set presence for your Slack app
scopes.users.profile:read: View profile details about people in a workspace
scopes.users.profile:write: Edit a user's profile information and status
scopes.workflows.templates:read: Manage Slack workflow template on user's behalf
scopes.workflows.templates:write: Write Slack workflow template on user's behalf

departures.canvases:write: Slack's page reads "your Slack app will be able to create, edit and remove canvases, Create, edit and remove canvases"; kept is its own short form, "Create, edit and remove canvases".
